ruleDefinitions.name: Dism Remove Online Package
ruleDefinitions.description: Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool. DISM is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\DismHost\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Online.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Disable\\-Feature.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\Dism\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Online.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Disable\\-Feature.*"))))
